official.deadline_central_display: October 2026 - 'To be announced later' (official wording) for every category, including NUET Applicants and international SAT/ACT applicants
official.status_note: The official Financial Aid & Scholarships page publishes the application deadline for all categories as 'October 2026 - To be announced later', and NUET 2027 dates as 'To be announced later'.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The fees page states financial support is available to applicants who obtain the minimum passing scores on the entrance exams and submit the required certificates, and that financial aid is not provided to applicants who apply to a fee-paying study, meet the minimum admission requirements, and do not take part in the competition for a Grant. Published tuition: Foundation Year Program USD 12,000 and undergraduate programmes USD 15,000 per academic year.
benefits: Tuition coverage under the financial support (state grant) competition for applicants meeting category minimums

Published aid options on the official fees page: 75% tuition coverage for socially vulnerable categories of citizens of Kazakhstan (orphans and children left without parental care under 29; persons with disabilities Group I, II or III; persons whose parents have such disabilities)

25% tuition coverage for undergraduate programmes for winners of listed international/republican subject Olympiads, and 25% for second and subsequent children from the same family on fee-paying programmes
50% tuition coverage for employees of Kazakhstan's government institutions and enterprises; an additional 5% if 100% of the annual tuition is paid in a single payment
Published annual tuition fees: USD 12,000 (NUFYP) and USD 15,000 (undergraduate); average monthly cost of attendance approximately USD 400, with accommodation guaranteed for international students
eligibility: Must first hold an admission offer from Nazarbayev University, then click 'Submit Financial Support Application' in the Personal Account

Select exactly one category: NUET Applicants, SAT/ACT Applicants, Winners of International and/or Republican Subject Olympiads, IB Diploma Holders, A-Level/NIS Grade 12 Certificate Holders, or NUFYP Students
Application is considered only if the minimum requirements for the selected category are met
NUET: 120 total with at least 50 in each of Mathematics and Critical Thinking and Problem Solving (NUET fee 7,000 KZT)
Digital SAT 1140 or ACT 24 for the Foundation Year; Digital SAT 1240 or ACT 26 for undergraduate (international applicants only; in-person tests; last test dates SAT 05.12.2026, ACT 28.11.2026)
IB Diploma: 30 total with 4, 4 and 5 in three Higher Level subjects; A-Level/NIS Grade 12: not less than ABB in any three subjects (final certificates issued 2025-2026)
Olympiad winners: gold or silver (I, II place) in the last year for the Republican Olympiad; gold, silver or bronze in the last three years for the International Olympiad; interview required
English: IELTS 6.0 (writing 6.0; reading, listening, speaking 5.5) for undergraduate or IELTS 5.5 (writing and reading 5.5; listening and speaking 5.0) for NUFYP, or equivalent TOEFL
requirements: A current Nazarbayev University admission offer
Meet the minimum requirements of the selected category - otherwise the application will not be considered

Official electronic IELTS/TOEFL results sent through the Testing Center (IELTS code: NU, Admissions Office; TOEFL iBT code 6762) plus a scanned copy uploaded to the Personal Account; in-person tests only, results valid if not expiring before 1 August 2027
Official electronic SAT/ACT results sent by the College Board (SAT 7915, ACT 5521) plus scanned certificate
Pay the NUET fee within the deadline if the NUET category is selected - applications without payment will not be processed
documents: Scanned copy of the IELTS or TOEFL certificate (with electronic results sent through the Testing Center)
Official electronic SAT or ACT results sent by the College Board, plus a scanned copy of the certificate
IB Diploma results, or final A-Level/NIS Grade 12 certificates issued in 2025 or 2026
Olympiad results documentation, if applying under the Olympiad category
NUET result, if applying under the NUET category (no document upload required for NUET)
selection_criteria: Category minimum requirements must be met or the application is not considered
SAT/ACT and IB/A-Level certificates are considered without superscoring
Incomplete or incorrectly submitted applications that are not corrected will not be considered
coverage: Financial support in the form of tuition coverage (grant competition) for applicants meeting category minimums

Published tuition-coverage percentages: 75% (socially vulnerable citizens of Kazakhstan), 50% (government institution/enterprise employees), 25% (Olympiad winners, undergraduate; second and subsequent siblings), 5% (single full payment)
Published annual tuition: USD 12,000 Foundation Year Program, USD 15,000 undergraduate
application_method: Apply for admission and receive an offer through admissions.nu.edu.kz
In the Personal Account, click 'Submit Financial Support Application' in the Admission Results section and complete the form
Select the single category under which the application will be considered and upload confirming documents (none for NUET)
Submit - once submitted, the form and uploaded documents cannot be changed
Monitor email including Spam for the Admissions Office notification and any correction deadline
official.application_route: First secure an admission offer via admissions.nu.edu.kz, then submit one financial support application in the Personal Account under a single category; only one application per person.
official.study_mode: Full-time (NUFYP is a one-year full-time programme; undergraduate is a four-year programme)
official.international_eligibility: Yes - international applicants are expressly catered for via the SAT/ACT category (Digital SAT 1140 or ACT 24 for the Foundation Year; Digital SAT 1240 or ACT 26 for undergraduate, taken in person, valid to 1 August 2027), and via IB, A-Level/NIS Grade 12 and Olympiad categories; the 75% socially-vulnerable and 50% government-employee coverages are published for citizens of Kazakhstan.
official.duration: One-year Nazarbayev University Foundation Year Program (NUFYP) or a four-year undergraduate bachelor's programme
official.description: Nazarbayev University's financial aid and scholarships route gives admitted Foundation Year and undergraduate applicants a second, separate competition for tuition coverage: applicants choose one of six published categories, must meet that category's minimum results, and submit the application in the Personal Account after receiving an admission offer.
official.program_type: University financial aid and scholarships (tuition coverage through the grant competition)
official.english_requirement: IELTS 6.0 overall (writing 6.0; reading, listening and speaking 5.5) for undergraduate programmes, or IELTS 5.5 overall (writing and reading 5.5; listening and speaking 5.0) for the Foundation Year Program, or the equivalent TOEFL score; tests must be taken in person at a test centre (IELTS Online, TOEFL iBT Home Edition and TOEFL PDT are not accepted), One Skill Retake results are accepted, and results must not expire before 1 August 2027; official electronic results must be sent through the Testing Center.

verification.notes: Read the official Financial Aid & Scholarships page (four-step application, six categories, category minimums, English rules, October 2026 'to be announced' deadlines) and the official Fees and financial support page (tuition fees, aid coverage percentages, cost of living); no award amount, stipend or insurance component is published on either page.

applicant_utility.summary: At Nazarbayev University the scholarship is a second competition you enter only after an admission offer exists: log into the Personal Account, click 'Submit Financial Support Application', and pick exactly one of six categories, because a below-minimum result in that category means the application is not considered at all. International applicants normally compete through the SAT/ACT category, and the official page fixes both the scores and the last acceptable test dates, so book an in-person SAT (by 5 December 2026) or ACT (by 28 November 2026) early. The prize is tuition coverage toward published fees of USD 12,000 (Foundation Year) or USD 15,000 (undergraduate), with the university separately estimating about USD 400 a month for living expenses that you must fund yourself.
applicant_utility.best_fit: High-scoring international school-leavers with strong in-person SAT/ACT, IB or A-Level results who can separately cover roughly USD 400 a month of living costs in Astana.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your category and that your result clears its minimum (SAT 1140/ACT 24 for NUFYP; SAT 1240/ACT 26 for undergraduate; IB 30 with 4,4,5 at HL; A-Level ABB)
Sit an in-person IELTS or TOEFL and have the electronic result sent to code NU (TOEFL iBT 6762) before applying - home editions are not accepted
Score the SAT/ACT in person before the published last dates (SAT 5 December 2026, ACT 28 November 2026) and have College Board send results to codes 7915/5521
Hold the admission offer first - financial support cannot be applied for before it
If choosing NUET, pay the 7,000 KZT fee inside the deadline or the application is not processed
common_rejection_risks: Submitting a financial support application without an admission offer, or paying the guarantee fee and accepting regular admission instead
Missing the category minimum by a small margin - there is no partial credit and the application is simply not considered
Remote or home-edition English tests, or results that expire before 1 August 2027
Changing documents after submission - the form and uploads are locked once submitted
Test-rules violations during NUET, which cancel results and block the financial support application
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Any tuition share beyond the coverage granted, plus living costs of roughly USD 400 a month (dining about USD 300, dormitory about USD 55, transport, laundry, sports and additional medical insurance) and flights to Astana; the university publishes no stipend or travel allowance on these pages.
document_audit: Electronic test results must travel through the official channels (Testing Center for IELTS/TOEFL, College Board for SAT/ACT) and a scanned copy must also sit in the Personal Account - a scan alone is not enough
A-Level/NIS Grade 12 certificates must be final certificates issued in 2025 or 2026; provisional or earlier documents are not accepted
Results are read without superscoring, so do not assume best-section combining will lift you over the threshold
alerts: Only one financial support application is allowed per person, and the chosen category cannot be switched after submission
Accepting a regular fee-paying offer and paying the guarantee fee forfeits consideration for financial support
The deadline is published only as 'October 2026 - To be announced later', so check the page and your email regularly, including the Spam folder
NUET results have no appeal procedure and are released roughly six weeks after the test
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Admission offer first, then a single locked-in financial support application in the Personal Account under one category, with category documents uploaded; corrections, if any, are notified by email within a stated deadline.
